statements.statement: The patient presents with persistent palpitations
The patient has a history of symptomatic bradycardia
The patient's condition is consistent with sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
CPT 93226 represents a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The service is for continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic evaluation
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that care may be covered by another payer in accordance with coordination of benefits protocols
Prairie State Medicaid is the secondary payer
